title: Some users' Exchange Online email messages may not be retrieved when prompting Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
impact: Users' Exchange Online email messages may not be retrieved when prompting Copilot Chat.

updates.content:
Title: We're looking into a potential problem impacting Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat

User impact: We're checking for potential impact to your users.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue impacting Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Some users' Exchange Online email messages may not be retrieved when prompting Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat

User impact: Users' Exchange Online email messages may not be retrieved when prompting Copilot Chat.

More info: Some Exchange Online email messages between July 22, 2026, and today may not be retrieved by Copilot Chat when prompted. While we index the affected email messages to our semantic index model, users can prompt Copilot Chat using exact wording to retrieve the email messages. 

Current status: We've identified that a service change introduced a misconfiguration that prevented Exchange Online email messages between July 22, 2026, and today from being indexed by our semantic index model. We're developing multiple fixes to ensure new email messages would be indexed and to index the email messages that were missed during the impact window.

Scope of impact: Some users that are attempting to prompt Copilot Chat to retrieve details from Exchange Online email messages between July 22, 2026, and today may be impacted.

Start time: Wednesday, July 22, 2026, at 10:07 PM UTC

Root cause: A service change introduced a misconfiguration that prevented Exchange Online email messages between July 22, 2026, and today from being indexed by our semantic index model, causing impact.

Next update by: Friday, September 11, 2026, at 7:30 PM UTC

Title: Some users' Exchange Online email messages may not be retrieved when prompting Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat

User impact: Users' Exchange Online email messages may not be retrieved when prompting Copilot Chat.

More info: Some Exchange Online email messages between July 22, 2026, and today may not be retrieved by Copilot Chat when prompted. While we index the affected email messages to our semantic index model, users can prompt Copilot Chat using exact wording to retrieve the email messages.

Current status: We've confirmed that all new email messages are being indexed correctly as a result of our fix. Scope of impact: Some users that are attempting to prompt Copilot Chat to retrieve details from Exchange Online email messages between July 22, 2026, and today may be impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Root cause: A service change introduced a misconfiguration that prevented Exchange Online email messages between July 22, 2026, and today from being indexed by our semantic index model, causing impact.
